title: HB171 (2025 Regular): Public Safety - Handgun Permits - Expiration and Renewal Periods for Retired Law Enforcement Officer

provenance.fetched_by: Open States bulk data (Maryland) (gun-policy Stage 5, Maryland); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Mississippi text (First Reader; official copy, https://mgaleg.maryland.gov/2025RS/bills/hb/hb0171f.pdf)
provenance.note: First reader as filed; no vote on record. Conforming edits to § 5-309(a) and (b) (cross-references to subsection (e)) are not quoted.

operative_text: Section 1 (Md. Code Ann., Public Safety § 5-309(e)): A PERMIT ISSUED TO A RETIRED LAW ENFORCEMENT OFFICER WHO RETIRED IN GOOD STANDING FROM SERVICE WITH A LAW ENFORCEMENT AGENCY OF THE STATE OR A COUNTY OR MUNICIPAL CORPORATION OF THE STATE: (1) EXPIRES ON THE LAST DAY OF THE HOLDER’S BIRTH MONTH FOLLOWING 5 YEARS AFTER THE DATE THE PERMIT IS ISSUED; AND (2) SUBJECT TO SUBSECTION (C) OF THIS SECTION, MAY BE RENEWED FOR SUCCESSIVE PERIODS OF 5 YEARS EACH IF, AT THE TIME OF AN APPLICATION FOR RENEWAL, THE APPLICANT POSSESSES THE QUALIFICATIONS FOR THE ISSUANCE OF A PERMIT.
